quest.title: Keeping Wanmin's Patrons Fed
quest.description: Once again, it's the Lantern Rite — and once again, Wanmin Restaurant's Chef Mao is busier than ever...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I wonder how things are back in Inazuma...

talks.objective: Head to Wanmin Restaurant to have a look

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: How many more dishes was that again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: What am I doing? Why, I'm running Wanmin Restaurant, of course! Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Things have been getting busy with everyone going out to eat during the Lantern Rite. Even travelers from faraway lands have come to visit and join the festivities.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Even though my dear Xiangling has returned to help, we're still struggling to keep our heads above water. As a matter of fact, she just went out on a delivery...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: While everyone else has been out hanging lanterns for the festival, we've been too busy to make a single lantern yet.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, Traveler, could you lend us a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Do you happen to know Atsuko? She's the girl from Inazuma down by the docks.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: We've prepared her order, so could you please go deliver the food to her? I've even made her extra large portions to celebrate the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: There's also the others who work down by the docks... <color=#00E1FFFF>Wrench Wang, Hammer Li, Guanhai, and Zhihua</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: They're regular patrons here and always look after our business. They seem to still be busy with work down by the docks, even though it's time for the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I would like to prepare some food to give them, but I'm afraid that we're simply too busy and won't have the chance to leave the restaurant...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: If you could, Traveler, please help me ask them what they would like to eat, and I'll whip up whatever they request.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Thanks a lot, Traveler. Just come back here and let me know once you've asked them.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I wonder why my order from Wanmin Restaurant hasn't arrived yet...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's your order. Enjoy!

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you so much! I'd thought that it would still take a while longer before it arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: All the festivities for Lantern Rite have been making me feel a little homesick... But I certainly won't be returning to Inazuma any time soon.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I wonder how things are back in Inazuma...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, this dish is best while it's hot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Black-Back Perch Stew</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Ah yes, Wanmin Restaurant's signature dish. I've eaten it many times already, and it doesn't have that sweet and sour taste I'm hankering after... I think I'd prefer something else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Crystal Shrimp</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Hmm, there's no fish in that dish, is there? Besides, the flavor's too bland, I think I'd prefer something else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Squirrel Fish</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Oh right, that's the one! How could I forget Squirrel Fish!?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Sweet and sour flavor with a crispy texture. I'm getting hungry just thinking about it. I can't wait to taste more of Chef Mao's cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Tianshu Meat</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: That dish is a little too oily...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Grilled Tiger Fish</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Grilled Tiger Fish is good and all... But the flavor is a little too strong for me and I'll smell like grilled fish for the rest of the day...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Lotus Flower Crisp</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Mm, that sounds good. It's nice and light and tastes great. That'll be perfect...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Alright, put me down for Lotus Flower Crisp, please.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Triple-Layered Consommé</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: I've heard storytellers say that it takes only one bite to finish all the soup of Triple-Layered Consommé. How 'bout something else?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: When have you ever gone to listen to stories? And why didn't you bring me along?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Come and Get It</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: I've heard storytellers say that Come and Get It is an exquisite dish, but there's no bamboo shoots. How 'bout something else?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Since when do storytellers ever talk about recipes? I've never heard them do that before...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Bamboo Shoot Soup</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: That's a good one! I've heard a storyteller describe it once as a dish that's "simmered to perfection over a low flame, with a distinctive savory taste."

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Sounds pretty good to me, let's get that one then.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Did you deliver the food?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, we did.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Great, I knew that I could count on you! Did you also happen to ask Wrench Wang, Guanhai, and Zhihua what they would like to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wrench Wang and Hammer Li would like to have Bamboo Shoot Soup.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Oh? These two have rather similar tastes, though Bamboo Shoot Soup will take some time to make. I'll have to start preparing it early.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Guanhai would like to have Squirrel Fish.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: No problem, that dish is one of my specialties.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Zhihua would like to have Lotus Flower Crisp.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Huh, I never would have guessed that Zhihua would have a liking for pastries and the like. Making Lotus Flower Crisp is straightforward enough, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Thanks for going and asking them what they'd like to eat. Here, take this as a token of my appreciation. Now, I should get started on all those dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Won't you be hanging any Xiao Lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Hah! We don't have time for that now, I've got more dishes to make and Xiangling has just gone out on another delivery...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: The two of us can barely keep up with the orders as it is. There's no way we'd have any time for hanging lanterns.

choices.text: I can take care of it for you.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Y—You'd really do that? I'll leave the lantern to you then. I was just starting to worry that the restaurant doesn't look festive enough without any lanterns.

choices.text: I'll make a Xiao Lantern for you.

talks.objective: Give the Xiao Lantern to Chef Mao

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: This Xiao Lantern looks great! I'll be sure to write a wish on it shortly. Once Xiangling gets back, we can release the lantern together as father and daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, take these as a token of my appreciation.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: I'll never finish all this work...

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Let's finish this up so we can finally have a rest and enjoy the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Chef Mao would like to treat you to a meal...

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, I remember Chef Mao did say something about treating us to a meal during Lantern Rite. I guess he was serious, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: This is too good to be true! Please give Chef Mao my thanks...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what would you like to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: I'm not going to ask for too much, I'd be more than satisfied with just a sumptuous bowl of <color=#00E1FFFF>hot soup</color> and some <color=#00E1FFFF>crisp bamboo shoots</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: I'm not picky, <color=#00E1FFFF>anything with meat is good enough for me</color>. I'm not one for fine dining, so what do you suggest?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Hmm, so that won't be any good. What else can you recommend?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: *sigh* Here I am working while everyone else is out enjoying the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Chef Mao would like to treat you to a meal...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Chef Mao would like to treat me to a meal? Hmm, it would be nice to kick back with a good meal and enjoy the festivities.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what would you like to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I really love the taste of <color=#00E1FFFF>fish</color>. It would be great if it was <color=#00E1FFFF>fish</color> paired with some special flavor — say, <color=#00E1FFFF>sweet-and-sour</color>, perhaps...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I can't think of anything special off the top of my head. What would you recommend?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Hmm, can you recommend something else?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: As soon as I'm finished with work, I'll go release Xiao Lanterns with Qiming...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Chef Mao would like to treat you to a meal...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: You say Chef Mao wants to treat me? That's great!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what would you like to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: But I'm planning to invite Qiming to release Xiao Lanterns later, so I'd prefer <color=#00E1FFFF>something without fish or meat</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>something without a strong flavor</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Maybe something like <color=#00E1FFFF>a light pastry</color> would be best?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Do you have any recommendations?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: How about something else... Do you have any other recommendations?

dialogues.speaker: Wrench Wang
dialogues.text: Let's put our backs into it! Once we're through with this, we can finally eat!

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Alright, back to work...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I can't wait for some Lotus Flower Crisp...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: *sigh* Here I am still working while everyone else is out enjoying the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Is the Xiao Lantern ready yet?
